name: Dirac Pixel Kernel
definition: A pixel kernel for backprojection that treats all pixels traversed by a projection line equally, assigning equal importance to all projection lines passing through a pixel. It is derived from the continuous Radon transform equation but does not solve sampling errors on projections.
summary: The Dirac Pixel Kernel is a binary weighting function for tomographic back-projection that treats pixels as switches, distinguishing itself by ignoring geometric path-length variations.
